manifest.purpose: Hardened implementation of int dispatch(uint8_t command, uint8_t privilege, uint32_t argument, uint32_t *state, uint8_t *status). Enforces privilege check: commands 0x10 and 0x11 require privilege==1; if privilege==0, return -1, set *status=0xFE, leave *state unchanged. Commands 0x01 and 0x02 work regardless of privilege. Unknown commands return -1, *status=0xFF, *state unchanged. WRITE_CONFIG_LO (0x10) updates lower 16 bits of *state with lower 16 bits of argument. WRITE_CONFIG_HI (0x11) updates upper 16 bits of *state with lower 16 bits of argument. No dynamic allocation, stateless except *state. Compiles with g++ -Wall -Wextra.

Header declaring the dispatch function signature: int dispatch(uint8_t command, uint8_t privilege, uint32_t argument, uint32_t *state, uint8_t *status). Includes <cstdint> for fixed-width types. Unchanged from baseline but required for compilation.
